authorization.capture: Host-authenticated explicit native user opt-in only. Never deserialize Origin from plugin/model JSON; never use a source/client label as permission.
authorization.producer: Host derives immutable producer/profile from the registered plugin. No plugin private-authority imports.
authorization.consumer: Host-authenticated original session subscriber; independently validate the same descriptor on live, replay and canonical receipt before persistence/render/speech.
authorization.gate: Required transaction-local profile, physical target, route, current consent revision and required producer/version check. Missing implementation/registration is denial.
authorization.unknown: Never retry authority. No old 299 resubmission, journal clearing, new event ID, or alternative session fallback.
authorization.revocation: Commit revocation before new claims; terminal completion and delivery must revalidate. effectsStopped remains false while any exact consumer effect owner retains custody. Already emitted effects cannot be recalled.

canonicalization.encoding: Strict UTF-8, sorted ASCII object keys, compact JSON separators, no Unicode/newline normalization, array order preserved, no floats/NaN; integers in JavaScript safe range.
canonicalization.digest: SHA256 of schemaVersion,bindingId,host origin,consentRevision,expiresAt,maxAdmissions,eventId,kind,payload. Host computes the authoritative digest.
canonicalization.idempotencyKey: producer + bindingId + eventId; the canonical request ID is a SHA256-derived namespaced identity.
